answers.reason: The dean is not mentioned as a member of the senate.
The budget planning round is part of the central leadership and administration.
The description does not include the dean in the appointment committee.
The dean leads one faculty and chairs its council.
The study commission is not chaired or led by the dean according to the rules.
Examination matters are handled by specific officers and boards, not the dean.
The internal research funding round is separate from the dean's direct council duties.
Module revision is handled by a working group separate from the dean.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a separate specialized body.
Orientation week planning is done by a separate group.
